name: backseat-driver-dev
description: Development tooling for the Backseat Driver plugin. Nothing here ships to users: the plugin is the plugin/ folder. TypeScript checks the types. spago and esbuild build the PureScript kernel into plugin/hooks/kernel.js, and the compiler itself comes by pinned hash (scripts/toolchain.py).

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate ./plugin --strict
scripts.licenses: cmp LICENSE plugin/LICENSE && cmp THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md plugin/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.check: npm run kernel && npm run validate && npm run licenses && npm run test && npm run typecheck
